name: Tate Gallery Engraving Artworks
title: Tate Gallery Engraving Artworks
description: All engraving-medium artworks in the Tate Gallery collection (excluding etchings), covering woodcuts, line engravings, mezzotints, and aquatints from the 16th century onward.
